facts.summary: Interim data showed no meaningful tumor response, plus restructuring and dilutive $25M offering · Phase 1 · BPX-601 in pancreatic cancer · not yet approved

evidence.summary: Clinically meaningful efficacy as measured by RECIST criteria was not observed.
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: Clinically meaningful efficacy as measured by RECIST criteria was not observed.
evidence.safety: Findings from the first four patients treated with BPX-601 followed by repeat rimiducid dosing showed a manageable safety profile and evidence of rimiducid-mediated CAR-T cell activation.
evidence.program_discontinued: review our plans in pancreatic cancer upon completion of the current safety cohort
